description:
MAIN-PARA's EIBCALEN = 0 guard at app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:90-92 - the cold start, entered with no commarea at all. The program moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN immediately, so no map is ever sent and USRSEC is never touched: the response is therefore the ENTIRE observable behaviour of this path, which is why all 22 commarea fields are pinned field by field rather than left implicit. RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN at :197-208 finds CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM already set so its :199-201 guard is a no-op, then writes CDEMO-FROM-TRANID from WS-TRANID at :202, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM from WS-PGMNAME at :203 and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT from MOVE ZEROS at :204 before the XCTL at :205-208 - which is projected as a nextProgram response field, statelessly, with no server-side forward. Because the MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) at :94 is not reached, every other field carries WORKING-STORAGE's initial state: spaces for each PIC X item, zeros for each PIC 9 item, and 'N' for CDEMO-CU03-NEXT-PAGE-FLG, the one item CDEMO-CU03-INFO declares a VALUE for at :54. No AID is declared because EIBAID is never read here and naming a key would imply it mattered. The two blank message lines are not an omission and not an invention: :87-88 move SPACES to WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO of COUSR3AO unconditionally, BEFORE the :90 test, so an 80-character and a 78-character blank line are genuinely observable on this path and are pinned on their own channels at their own declared widths. USRSEC is seeded even though it is never read, so that 'nothing was written' is a positive assertion: expectedWrites is empty and all ten rows are pinned unchanged at indices 0-9, each as its six CSUSR01Y fields and as its full 80-byte image. PROVENANCE: every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of the sources below and is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL - running it is empirically impossible in this environment (no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler's indexed-file handler is disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository), which is the documented eight-blocker deviation escalated as risk R-A; it changes the provenance of the expected values and nothing else. Derived from app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:87-92 and :197-208, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 with app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:50-58, app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 (8+20+20+8+1 = 57, plus SEC-USR-FILLER's 23 = 80), app/cpy-bms/COUSR03.CPY (eleven xxxI items, no password item), and the ten in-stream rows of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose 57-character width against the LRECL=80/RECFM=FB of :48 and the RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) of :65-66 is exactly what the declared normalisation supplies. The literal PASSWORD in SEC-USR-PWD is legacy sample data carried byte for byte because the copybook places it inside the eighty bytes; plaintext credentials are an inherited property of the legacy design rather than a choice made here, this screen has no password field and never reads or paints the span, and no hashing, encoding or token is introduced. This is the FOUNDATIONAL, convention-setting case for parity/COUSR03C: the ten-row seed block, the pinned 2022-07-19T23:12:35 clock taken from the version footer at :358, the six record field names and the 57-to-80 normalisation established here are what case02 through case20 must match.

THE OPERATION ORDER, DECLARED RATHER THAN INFERRED. expectedOperations names every USRSEC operation this case must issue, in order, and it is an assertion a byte fingerprint structurally cannot make: the EXEC CICS DELETE at app/cbl/COUSR03C.cbl:307-311 names no RIDFLD, so it removes the record the task is HOLDING and is only ever correct after the EXEC CICS READ ... UPDATE at :269-278 took that hold on the same record. An empty list is equally an assertion - it says this path never reached the file at all.
